shots.name: desktop_day_start
shots.js: t.ui.help(true); t.ui.banner('inner_city'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return t.ui.state().places;

shots.name: desktop_day_toast
shots.js: t.ui.help(false); t.ui.toast('S6.bld.sunyang_zhengdian'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300)); return t.ui.state().places;

shots.name: desktop_day_prompt
shots.js: await t.goto(-11.6, 7.4); t.player.yaw = 118*Math.PI/180 - Math.PI/2; t.player.pitch=-0.12; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800)); return t.ui.state().talk;

shots.name: desktop_day_talk_barber
shots.js: t.ui.talk('V5.5'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2600)); t.ui.next(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); t.ui.next(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300)); return t.ui.state().talk.conv;

shots.name: desktop_day_talk_tax
shots.js: t.ui.close(); await t.goto(-36.4, 7.3); t.player.yaw = 84*Math.PI/180 - Math.PI/2; t.player.pitch=-0.14; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); t.ui.talk('V5.1'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); t.ui.next(); t.ui.next(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300)); return t.ui.state().talk.conv;

shots.name: desktop_day_plaques_gate
shots.js: t.ui.close(); await t.goto(-28.5, 3.5); t.player.yaw = 0*Math.PI/180 - Math.PI/2; t.player.pitch=-0.05; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return t.ui.state().places.plaques;

shots.name: desktop_night_banner_toast
shots.js: await t.view('inner_city:spawn'); t.ui.banner('gate'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); t.ui.toast('S5.str.moat_bridge'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2200)); return t.ui.state().places;

shots.name: desktop_night_talk
shots.js: await t.goto(-36.4, 7.3); t.player.yaw = 84*Math.PI/180 - Math.PI/2; t.player.pitch=-0.14; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); t.ui.talk('V5.1'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); t.ui.next(); t.ui.next(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1300)); return t.ui.state();

shots.name: desktop_night_help
shots.js: t.ui.close(); t.ui.help(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));

shots.name: desktop_day_hud
shots.js: t.ui.help(false); await t.hud.show(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); return t.hud.stats();
